# skyhub_wan_status (Data Source)

WAN link state, addressing and firmware version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skyhub_wan_status" "w" {}

output "public_ipv4" {
  value = data.skyhub_wan_status.w.ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `delegated_prefix` (String) Delegated IPv6 prefix.
- `dns` (List of String) Upstream DNS servers.
- `dsl_firmware` (String) DSL modem firmware version.
- `firmware` (String) Hub firmware version.
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway.
- `id` (String) Always `wan_status`.
- `interface` (String) WAN interface, e.g. `ptm0.1`.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `ipv6` (String) WAN IPv6 address with prefix length.
- `ipv6_gateway` (String) IPv6 gateway (link-local).
- `mac` (String) WAN MAC address.
- `modem_state` (String) DSL modem state.
- `netmask` (String) WAN netmask.
- `protocol` (String) e.g. `ipoe`.
- `router_mode` (String) `ADSL`, `WANOE` or `AUTO`.
- `up` (Boolean) WAN connection is up.
- `uptime_seconds` (Number) WAN uptime in seconds.
